# Seema General Contracting & Industrial Services

> Saudi specialist in structural rehabilitation, carbon-fiber composite reinforcement (CFRP), process piping repair, industrial epoxy coatings, and acid-resistant linings for refineries, petrochemical plants, and heavy industry across the Kingdom.

Seema (EST. 2013) delivers engineered repair solutions that reduce downtime and extend asset life for SABIC, Aramco, Ma'aden, SEC, SIPCHEM, YASREF, and other major industrial operators. Headquartered in Jubail with a branch office in Dammam.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Company overview, capabilities, and approved-vendor credentials.
- [About](/about): History since 2013, mission, vision, leadership, and certifications.
- [Services](/services): Carbon-fiber reinforcement, concrete and steel rehabilitation, process pipe repair, epoxy coatings, acid lining, expansion joints, waterproofing, and industrial supplies.
- [Projects](/projects): Major orders completed for oil & gas, petrochemical, power, and industrial sectors.
- [Clients](/clients): Approved vendor registrations and long-standing client partnerships.
- [Contact](/contact): Jubail and Dammam office addresses, phone numbers, and inquiry form.
